g.text: Full label budgets; within-dataset ACC-motion terciles are movement proxies, not noise labels
ACC is used only for descriptive stratification, never as model input; tercile thresholds differ between datasets.
Participants with observations in each stratum are weighted equally. † Conditional on finite estimates; see strata.csv for coverage.
